newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - BANGLADESH NEWSPAPERS - AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - BANGLADESH NEWSPAPERS - AUG 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Water experts from Bangladesh and India on Sunday inspected the changed course of the river Teesta.
Indian army chief General Shanker Roy Chowdhury on Sunday said there were opportunities for Indo-Bangladesh military cooperation.
State Minister for Local Government and Cooperatives Syed Abul Hossain resigned on Monday as a sequel to his controversial trip to Singapore without official permission.
A F-28 aircraft of Bangladesh Biman airlines averted a mishap on Sunday as its main wheel punctured after touching the tarmac of Dhaka airport.
The government has taken initiative to sign extradition treaty with different countries to bring back alleged killers of the independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
Privatisation Board Chairman said on Sunday a legal framework on privatisation would be finalised within the current month.
Opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Sunday said deteriorating law and order situation was scaring away foreign investors.
The government on Sunday decided to make vailable additional funds to ensure fair prices of jute at growers' level. REUTER
